idea: Implement the known optimal-pattern generator directly: for n = k² + 2m + 1 use Erdős–Soifer with the (m+1)×(m+1) refinement. For n = k² − 2m − 1 use the shrinking version, and for even residues combine one expanding and one shrinking replacement in disjoint corners of the same k-grid. Evaluate all (k, m1, m2) and validate with an exact Fraction overlap checker before returning.
